steps.steps: When a note moves to the very next line or space, it moves by a step: to the neighboring white key. Put your right thumb on middle {c}, one finger per key, and follow the notes up and down.
steps.readWithNames: Read the melody from the staff. For now, the note names are written under the notes.
steps.readWithout: Another melody, this time without names. Look at each note’s line or space.
steps.inTime: Now play it in time with the metronome.
